heading: Your performance. Yours to keep.
description: Your photos, videos and performance memories—all in your DancePro account.
body: One account for your studios, events, purchases and messages.

sections.title: Create your account
sections.body: Sign up once, or sign in if you already have a DancePro account.

sections.title: Add your studio or event
sections.body: Add your dance studio or competition in My Media. Use the access code supplied by your studio or event where required.

sections.title: Access your photos & videos
sections.body: Browse released galleries, purchase your favourites and watch or download the videos available in your account.
